compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
(GREEN task: DD ownership lies with the RED test tasks. task-1 owns dd-2 + resolver-layer dd-8; task-2 owns dd-1/3/4/5/6/7 + shim-layer dd-8. This task's success criterion is the previously-RED tests turning GREEN.)

## Implementation Notes

Depends on: task-1 (7fff-f993-f995-48d1) AND task-2 (0a26-fb8c-cde5-4e84)

### Python module: plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry_emit.py
- Python ≥3.11 (matches project pyproject.toml requires-python)
- Stdlib ONLY — no pytest-httpserver, no requests, no httpx
- argparse CLI: `--event-type`, `--key`, `--link`, `--cited-excerpt`, `--endpoint`, per-event-type field overrides
- 11 `_resolve_<field>()` functions per task-1 spec
- `_apply_layer_a_privacy(envelope, config)` — when `emit_excerpts` config is false/unset AND `client_id != "dso-self"`, set envelope `cited_excerpt=None`
- `_register_key(event_id, key)` and `_lookup_link(key)` — use direct `fcntl.flock` on sidecar lockfile `${DSO_TELEMETRY_LEDGER_DIR}/.event-id-map.lock` (NOT `_flock_stage_commit` — that's for tickets branch only). Pattern from ticket-lib.sh lines 111-196 inline-python helper.
- `_check_idempotency(event_id)` — read `submitted.log`; if event_id present, return without POSTing.
- POST via `urllib.request.urlopen` with `socket.setdefaulttimeout`. Fail-open on every exception → exit 0 + stderr warning. Only exit 1 path: `_resolve_client_id()` raising ValueError on empty input (shim catches and exits 1 with clear "client_id: required and must be non-empty" message naming the field).
- `schema_version` MUST be numeric integer 1 (json.dumps outputs `1` not `"1"`).
- `event_type` constrained to enum of 5 values; raise ValueError on invalid input.
- When `telemetry.enabled=false` config is read, exit 0 immediately without POST (no-op).

### Bash shim: plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry-emit.sh
- Set -euo pipefail
- Forward "$@" to python module via `python3 "$SCRIPT_DIR/telemetry_emit.py" "$@"`
- Pass through exit code
- chmod +x at creation (always:chmod-x-new-sh)
- ShellCheck-clean

### After impl lands
- task-1 + task-2 tests should pass GREEN
- Remove `.test-index` RED marker entries for `tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py` and `tests/scripts/test-telemetry-emit.sh`

### CLI contract (referenced by task-2's tests)
```
telemetry-emit.sh --event-type <enum> [--endpoint URL] [--key LOGICAL_ID] [--link LOGICAL_ID] [--cited-excerpt TEXT] [--field-key=value ...]
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Python module exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry_emit.py
- [ ] Bash shim exists, executable, set -euo pipefail
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry-emit.sh && head -5 plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry-emit.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail'
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on bash shim
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry-emit.sh
- [ ] task-1 pytest tests now pass GREEN
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py
- [ ] task-2 bash tests now pass GREEN
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-telemetry-emit.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] _resolve_client_id raises ValueError on empty (behavioral check)
  Verify: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry'); from telemetry_emit import _resolve_client_id; raised=False
try: _resolve_client_id({'client_id': ''})
except ValueError: raised=True
sys.exit(0 if raised else 1)"
- [ ] schema_version emitted as numeric integer (not string)
  Verify: python3 -c "import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, 'plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry'); from telemetry_emit import _resolve_schema_version; v = _resolve_schema_version(); assert isinstance(v, int) and v == 1, f'expected int 1, got {type(v).__name__}({v!r})'"
- [ ] No new external dependencies added (pytest-httpserver banned per rule:risky-dep)
  Verify: ! git diff HEAD~3..HEAD -- pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^\+' | grep -qE 'pytest_httpserver|pytest-httpserver'
- [ ] Uses fcntl.flock (NOT _flock_stage_commit)
  Verify: grep -qE 'fcntl\.flock' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry_emit.py && ! grep -q '_flock_stage_commit' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry_emit.py
- [ ] .test-index RED markers removed for both test files
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'test-telemetry-emit\.sh \[' .test-index && ! grep -qE 'test_telemetry_emit_resolvers\.py' .test-index
- [ ] telemetry.enabled=false is a no-op (verified by task-2 test test_telemetry_disabled_noop)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-telemetry-emit.sh 2>&1 | grep -qE 'test_telemetry_disabled_noop.*PASS|FAILED: 0'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 5/5): language auto-detect + omit-vs-null. Pin heuristic: 'language defaults to None (omit field) when no --language flag passed; do NOT auto-derive from filesystem scanning'. Add AC: jq 'has("<field>") | not' for each optional field (pr_number, commit_sha, cycle, language, cited_excerpt) when unset — verifying JSON envelope OMITS the key (not emits null). Catches the json.dumps({'pr_number': None}) → 'null' schema violation per schema line 32.
